paragraphs: Ketubot 104a: Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak said that Rav Yehudah bar Kaza recited in the baraita of Bar Kaza’s school. Hyman adds that Rashi explains Bar Kaza as a sage’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The whole William Davidson paragraph at Ketubot 104a names Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak and Rav Yehudah bar Kaza and gives the school’s baraita. The whole Vilna Rashi comment reads “Bar Kaza—a sage’s name.” These are digital comparisons; the supplied leading ב and locator remain unchanged, without printed-source or identity verification.
